recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes the remaining implementer-visible stale link without restoring a removed profile or touching out-of-build legacy profile source. No further core work is needed unless SDWG creates a new ClinicalDocument profile in a future project.
issue_request: FHIR-13528 was Published / Persuasive with Modification. It originally requested renaming the Clinical Document profile to CDA on FHIR, but SDWG reopened the issue and voted to undo that direction: the profile should remain ClinicalDocument / Clinical Document, and CDA on FHIR or CDA in FHIR should not be used as the profile name.
initial_application: Commit 8610555c84de813fe4eb56b23123645881940256 initially renamed the Composition ClinicalDocument profile source to CDA on FHIR. Commit 9918d179fbe866e2bebc244da795cba15eb538ba applied the reopened resolution by reversing the rename, deleting CDA-on-FHIR profile source files, restoring ClinicalDocument source naming, and changing the Composition introduction from CDA on FHIR profile to Clinical Document profile.
additional_context: FHIR-34407 later removed the ClinicalDocument Composition profile entirely; commit 938bdf21940e09a728baa17dc0060c413a0054c7 deleted the current-source ClinicalDocument StructureDefinition and ImplementationGuide, and the combined branch already contains a FHIR-34407 audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini builds Composition as an active resource, but the legacy cda profile hook is commented out and the ClinicalDocument profile files are absent. The active Composition introduction still linked Clinical Document profile to composition-core.html, which now renders as an unrelated Composition HL7 Extensions page.
reconciliation: Updated source/composition/composition-introduction.xml so the active Composition page no longer claims that a ClinicalDocument profile constrains Composition or points to composition-core.html for the retired profile. The replacement text directs readers to the CDA-aware note and CDA comparison page for current Composition/CDA guidance. Retired out-of-build profile artifacts were not edited.
source_changes: source/composition/composition-introduction.xml: replaced the stale Clinical Document profile link to composition-core.html with current CDA-aware guidance links.
